title: An upper-bound conjecture for weighted Hermite polynomials
statement:
Let $H_n(x)$ denote the $n$th Hermite polynomial, let

$$
g_n(x)=\left(1-\frac{x^2}{2n+1}\right)^{-1/2},
$$

and set

$$
x_n=\sqrt{2n+1}\left(1-\frac{\pi}{2(2n+1)}\right).
$$

**Hermite-polynomial upper-bound conjecture.** For all $n\in\mathbb{N}^+$ and $x>0$,

$$
\left|H_n(x)\mathrm{e}^{-x^2}\right|\leq\frac{2^n\Gamma\left(\frac{n+1}{2}\right)}{\sqrt{\pi}}g_n(\min(x,x_n))\mathrm{e}^{-x^2/2}.
$$

The conjecture is motivated by the interpretation of $H_n(x)\mathrm{e}^{-x^2/2}$ as the unnormalized wave function of a quantum oscillator and is intended to improve estimates for the remainder term in the modified Euler–Maclaurin formula, particularly for large $m$. Its resolution is not specified in the source.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2004.10441

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of April 2020).
source_name: Jihong Guo and Yunpeng Liu, “A modified Euler-Maclaurin formula in 1D and 2D with applications in statistical physics”, arXiv:2004.10441 (2020).
